t: 伽利略抵达罗马，接受宗教裁判所的审判。
te: Galileo Galilei arrives in Rome for his trial before the Inquisition.
dz: 伽利略抵达罗马，接受宗教裁判所的审判。
de: Galileo Galilei arrives in Rome for his trial before the Inquisition.

t: 塞缪尔·德·钱普兰(Samuel de Champlain)代表红衣主教里切利乌(Richel…
te: Samuel de Champlain reclaims his role as commander of New France on behalf of Cardinal Richelieu.
dz: 塞缪尔·德·钱普兰(Samuel de Champlain)代表红衣主教里切利乌(Richelieu)重新夺回了自己作为新法国指挥官的角色.
de: Samuel de Champlain reclaims his role as commander of New France on behalf of Cardinal Richelieu.

t: 查尔斯一世在爱丁堡圣吉尔斯大教堂被加冕为苏格兰国王.
te: Charles I is crowned King of Scots at St Giles' Cathedral, Edinburgh.
dz: 查尔斯一世在爱丁堡圣吉尔斯大教堂被加冕为苏格兰国王.
de: Charles I is crowned King of Scots at St Giles' Cathedral, Edinburgh.

t: 罗马的神圣办公室迫使伽利略·加利莱(Galileo Galilei)重述他的观点,即太阳,而不…
te: The Holy Office in Rome forces Galileo Galilei to recant his view that the Sun, not the Earth, is the center of the Uni…
dz: 罗马的神圣办公室迫使伽利略·加利莱(Galileo Galilei)重述他的观点,即太阳,而不是地球,是他在激烈争议后提出的宇宙的中心.
de: The Holy Office in Rome forces Galileo Galilei to recant his view that the Sun, not the Earth, is the center of the Universe in the form he presented it in, after heated controversy.
